reviews_captured_by_me.text: Juan was awesome to work with & always delivered on exactly what he promised!

As a result of Ida, we had to get new kitchen cabinets. Juan came out to our appointment and we told him what we wanted. He said it would take about 3 weeks to build them and we should have everything in place within 4 weeks of the order so we ordered them. During the course of waiting for our cabinets, Juan was either getting confused with other orders or there was an unknown issue. He had tried to change the plans multiple times and without our consent. After excuses upon excuses, the cabinets finally arrived 6+ MONTHS after our initial order. Before they came, we had stripped everything out of the kitchen to prepare for the installation. When the cabinets FINALLY came they were not the same design that we ordered and it was the wrong color. Juan outright lied to us telling us that's what we ordered when in fact it wasn't. We were told that we could return them and order new ones. By this time after waiting so long and the fact that our kitchen was in shambles and unusable, we were forced to settle with what was delivered it just wasn't possible to wait another 6 months to get new ones. We were not pleased by this. No so much as even a 'I'm sorry' with the wrong order and color. Juan does not keep appointments. During the course of all this, he stood us up on 4 different occasions without even a courtesy call saying he wouldn't be arriving. Juan lacks any kind of integrity and is extremely unprofessional. Unbeknownst to us at the time, our neighbors even tried using them but had to fire them during the initial phase because of the same issues...not capable of getting orders straight, etc. We have had nothing but heartache dealing with Juan and a lot of wasted time our of our lives due to his incompetency.  As a matter of fact, there were some issues with the installed cabinets. Gaps between cabinets and walls, rust stains on the granite from handling at the warehouse, etc. He even stood us up telling he was going to come out and fix everything. That was the icing on the cake so I told them they were never allowed on our property again. We're thoroughly disgusted after spending a small fortune on cabinets and you can't even get what you ordered and what was delivered and messed up, they won't even correct the issues with you. I definitely will not give my business to United Kitchen & Bath in the future and if you were smart, you wouldn't either.

Spencer was my salesman and was very knowledgeable with the products he had to offer.  He measured the area and gave me several options and suggestions on the best fit for my kitchen.  He is a courteous, well mannered young man who knows what he's doing and did not pressure me purchase more than I needed.  The installation crew was also very efficient  I am very happy with my kitchen
